heading_en: Approval Standards for the Scenario Method
summary_ja: シナリオ法の承認に際して金融庁長官が審査する六つの基準を定める。
summary_en: Sets out the six standards the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency examines when approving the use of the scenario method.
paragraphs: When intending to grant approval for the use of the scenario method, the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency shall examine whether the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. conforms to the following standards to the extent necessary in light of its business operations: (i) the Market Risk Management Department is established independently of the departments involved in the transactions for which the market risk equivalent amount is calculated; (ii) the Market Risk Management Department periodically conducts verification of the appropriateness of the operation of the scenario method and prepares documents describing the procedures for conducting it; (iii) the officers, etc. of the Ultimate Designated Parent Company are actively involved in the market risk management procedures; (iv) the scenario method is closely integrated into the ordinary risk management procedures; (v) documents describing the internal policies, controls and procedures concerning the operation of the scenario method have been prepared, and measures have been taken to ensure that they are complied with; (vi) as a rule, an internal audit of the operation of the scenario method is conducted at least once a year.
